evidence.title: Change request CR-2008-005
evidence.claim: The ventilation and gas testing step was introduced in 2008 following an incident where an operator was overcome by solvent vapour in tank T-3.
evidence.quote: Reason: IR-2008-003 (operator overcome by solvent vapour in tank T-3).

evidence.title: Incident report IR-2008-003
evidence.claim: In 2008, an operator became dizzy from acetone vapours in tank T-3 because a gas detector was not used before entry.
evidence.quote: An operator entered tank T-3 after cleaning to recover a dropped tool and became dizzy after about 2 minutes.

evidence.title: Acetone consumption 2022
evidence.claim: Acetone is still used in SOP-07 as of 2022, meaning the risk of solvent vapours persists.
evidence.quote: acetone consumption in 2022 was 238,000 L, nearly all of it in SOP-07
